matrix.caption: What breaks, and what keeps working

rows.name: Element burns out mid-firing

one.text: The load is lost; the kiln is down until a new element arrives.

two.text: The second kiln carries the week's work.

rows.response: Order spare elements in pairs and keep one on the shelf.

rows.name: Planned maintenance

one.text: A day of cleaning is a day without firing.

two.text: Clean one while the other fires.

rows.response: Clean the cooler kiln the day after it fires.

rows.name: Power cut overnight

two.text: Both go down; a shared circuit changes nothing.

rows.response: Put both kilns on the same alarm and the same phone number.

rows.name: Vent fan fails

one.text: Fumes build; the interlock should refuse the next start.

rows.response: Test the interlock once a month.

ledger.caption: Checks before the first firing of the season
ledger.note: Happy path and error path for each control.

error.text: Refuses with the vent off and says why.

happy.text: Cuts the elements, keeps the vent.
Saved, but the display shows the old peak until a restart.
